_comment: Hook events from Reasonix v1.17.20. Two channels per event, each self-gating: herdr-agent-state.sh reports to herdr (and skips itself under TUIOS_ENV=1), while `tuios agent-hook claude-code` reads the hook payload on stdin, derives the event from hook_event_name, and reports natively to the tuios pane — outside tuios (TUIOS_ENV unset) it reports nothing. Lifecycle (herdr | tuios): SessionStart → idle | idle+session bind; UserPromptSubmit → working | working; Notification → blocked | needs_input when the payload names a permission message; PreToolUse (write tools) → blocked | working; PostToolUse → working | working (if_state needs_input); Stop → idle | done with last-line summary; SessionEnd → release | state cleared.

SessionStart.description: herdr: ensure idle state on session start
tuios: idle + agent session bind on session start

UserPromptSubmit.description: herdr: report working when user submits a prompt

Notification.description: herdr: report blocked when approval is needed (e.g. tool permission dialog)
tuios: needs_input when the notification is a permission prompt

PreToolUse.description: herdr: report blocked when file-writer tool is about to execute

PostToolUse.description: herdr: restore working after each tool call (transitions blocked→working)
tuios: restore working after an approval (if_state-guarded)

Stop.description: herdr: report idle when turn ends
tuios: done with last-line summary + turn activity

SessionEnd.description: herdr: release agent label when session ends
tuios: clear pane agent state (state none)
